svg.title: QuestProof: security questionnaires answered from your policies
svg.desc: A vendor security review sheet whose answers are written in one by one, each with a footnote quoting the policy section it came from; one question is left for a person.
svg.text: SIG · CAIQ · SOC 2 · ISO 27001 · NIST CSF

g.text: Every answer cites the policy section it came from.
What it cannot prove goes to a person.

svg.text: Is data kept on personal devices?
Is MFA required for remote access?
